name: npc-vscode
description: Mindless AI coding grunt agent for repetitive tasks and full-repo changes

pi.activeModel.description: The active model identifier used for NPC chat and completions (e.g. 'llama3.2', 'deepseek-chat').

pi.ollamaUrl.description: Base URL of the local Ollama instance.

pi.autoSyncOllama.description: Automatically detect and sync models from local Ollama on startup.

apiKey.description: API Key (optional if using local gateway)

label.description: Display label used by the NPC model picker

isOllama.description: Marks a model discovered from the configured Ollama instance

pi.terminalCommand.description: Command used to launch the NPC terminal agent.

pi.agentFeatures.guardrails.enabled.description: Enable NPC guardrail permission checks before tool execution.

pi.agentFeatures.guardrails.hooksEnabled.description: Run PreToolUse/PostToolUse declarative hooks when guardrails are enabled.

pi.agentFeatures.guardrails.evaluatorMod.description: Optional model reference used for structured safety evaluation of risky tool calls. Empty uses the active model.

enumDescriptions: Prompt before every guarded tool call; approval grants that call only.
Allow by default unless a specific rule blocks the action.
Ask when the policy requires approval; non-interactive clients fail closed.
Hard deny unless a specific rule produces an approval path; this does not prompt.
pi.agentFeatures.guardrails.defaultTier.description: Interactive default: deny until the user explicitly approves each guarded tool call.

pi.agentFeatures.switchyard.enabled.description: Enable the Switchyard capability-aware virtual model.

enumDescriptions: Lite mode (Recommended): Macro-task sticky routing to maximize KV cache hit rate and avoid cross-model prefill invalidation.
Full mode: Automatic turn-by-turn dynamic switching between efficient and capable tiers.
pi.agentFeatures.switchyard.mode.description: Switchyard execution mode (lite protects KV cache, full optimizes turn-level cost).

pi.agentFeatures.switchyard.efficientMod.description: Efficient model reference. Use 'NPC: Configure Switchyard Models' to choose from the current active provider.

pi.agentFeatures.switchyard.capableModel.description: Capable model reference used for escalation; configure from the current provider with 'NPC: Configure Switchyard Models'.

pi.agentFeatures.switchyard.picker.description: Routing bias when Switchyard scores a request.

pi.agentFeatures.personalization.enabled.description: Inject saved project/developer conventions into NPC prompts.

pi.agentFeatures.personalization.autoLea.description: Persist explicit Always/Never/Prefer conventions from user prompts.

pi.agentFeatures.personalization.maxToke.description: Approximate token budget for injected conventions.

pi.agentFeatures.semble.enabled.description: Enable the syntax-aware Semble code search tool in the agent tool loadout.

pi.agentFeatures.semble.maxResults.description: Default maximum Semble results. The tool may still receive an explicit per-call limit.

pi.agentFeatures.worktree.enabled.description: Experimental: isolate session file edits in a Git worktree. Cleanup is configurable; merge/reconciliation remains an explicit workflow.

pi.agentFeatures.worktree.rootDir.description: Optional root directory reserved for future isolated session worktrees.

pi.agentFeatures.worktree.cleanupOnDispo.description: Experimental cleanup preference for future worktree lifecycle integration.

pi.agentFeatures.openResearch.enabled.description: Enable autonomous open research across ArXiv, Wikipedia, and DuckDuckGo.

pi.agentFeatures.openResearch.maxResults.description: Default maximum references collected per research source.

pi.agentFeatures.proceduralGuidance.enab.description: Enable procedural graph guidance and next-step recommendations.

pi.agentFeatures.astImpact.enabled.description: Enable AST impact radius and continuous caller dependency tracking.

pi.agentFeatures.actionFusion.enabled.description: Enable atomic action fusion combining edits with immediate validation commands.

pi.agentFeatures.execCritic.enabled.description: Enable fail-closed test qualification against unmodified base code.

pi.agentFeatures.airgap.enabled.description: Enable zero-trust egress airgap flight mode blocking unauthorized network destinations.

pi.agentFeatures.prAutopilot.enabled.description: Enable PR autopilot generator for maintainer-ready pull request documents.

pi.agentFeatures.reduceOutput.enabled.description: Enable evidence-preserving test and command output reducer.

pi.agentFeatures.reduceOutput.maxChars.description: Maximum character budget for reduced output receipts.
